nodes.label: β2AR
props: G protein-coupled receptor for catecholamines that couples to both G(s) and G(i) proteins, activating bifurcated signaling pathways. ADRB2 binds epinephrine (Epi) with an approximately 30-fold greater affinity than norepinephrine (NE).

nodes.label: epinephrine
props: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R)-adrenaline, obtained by protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.
